title: Sheep coming down Burtt's hill to train station
description: This photograph, taken in the early 1900s, shows Burtt’s Hill (now Orser Street) looking up the hill, with the post office and Town Hall on the left today. The man in the light suit was Julius Myers, known as Jack the German. Standing beside the sheep wagon was Clarence (Cad) Hayward, with his son Sandy in front. Riding in the wagon are Mr. and Mrs. Sam Cook. The Scotch Collie dog, Old Fan, was guiding the sheep as they headed toward the train station’s holding pins.
